severeFindings.title: F-2 SEVERE — 433 condition-editor entries and 12 compressed ranges in two tools-guides files that were declared skipped and never opened
severeFindings.detail: mustReadSkipsDeclared collapses `tools-guides/the-query-builder-and-the-condition-editor-e10473f9.md` and `-af058a80.md` into one thing ("the Processor RUNTIME Query Builder ... deliberately excluded as do-not-confuse") and neither was opened. They are TWO DISTINCT SURFACES. e10473f9 = Invoice Processor: 7 Data Objects (the SAME seven members as the Workflows Condition page, each with a description the admin file lacks), 217 Field/Value entries, 7 compressed ranges (Address 1-3, Custom 01-10, Custom 01-15, Custom 01-20, Custom 01-24, Org Unit 1-6, Org Unit 4-6). af058a80 = PR Processor AND PO Processor: TWO further Data Object lists (PR: Employee, Purchase Request, Purchase Request Distribution, Purchase Request Item, Vendor Remittance Address; PO: Bill To, Employee, Purchase Order, Purchase Order Distribution, Purchase Order Item, Ship To, Vendor Remittance Address), 216 entries, 5 ranges. e10473f9:23 says, grep -F -c = 1: "The Query Builder window in Invoice Processor is very similar to the Condition page within several of the other features in the Invoice Configuration administrator." Against this the graph gives workflow_condition_field_value_c just 2+13 = 15 entries, from a table SAP itself opens (4d98af34, grep -F -c = 1) with "The table below shows a partial list of the options that appear for the Field / Value...". This is rule 1 (admin-skewed search losing a tools-guides catalog) and rule 2 (a ~250-name table skipped for length) simultaneously — twice. DO NOT home 433 values on Workflows: they belong to deferred Processor surfaces. Owed instead: (a) a contradiction node on workflow_condition_field_value_c/_f citing the two quotes above — 15 self-declared-partial vs 217 vs 216, coincidence unstated; (b) a free corroboration note on workflow_condition_data_object_b, since e10473f9 independently reproduces the same 7 members with descriptions; (c) an unbuilt-surface pointer so the deferred Processor pages inherit the 433 entries and 12 ranges instead of a future run re-discovering them at cost.

completeness.verdict: MERGE WITH REPAIRS. The build is mechanically sound: 281/281 sourceQuotes verify verbatim with zero bad sourceFile prefixes; the packed 3-row raw table in invoice-settings-cace748d.md is fully recovered (Settings tab = 9 controls, confirmed independently); all 5 in-scope compressed ranges are recorded with expansions; every in-group catalog I re-counted matches (13 approval statuses, 18 email variables corpus-wide-unique, 8+2+7+4 workflow steps, 8 Data Objects, 5 rule actions, 9 settings), and the build twice corrected its own map-inventory (Approval Time Expired Action is 5 values not 3; Assignment Timeout Action is {No Action, Submit Request}, not the two the map mis-assigned). Feature Hierarchies' thinness is proven honest — 24 files mention "Feature Hierarch", 23 were read, zero contain a raw table, and I read both primary procedures end to end. uiVariant "undifferentiated" is earned: no new-experience or legacy twin of either page exists anywhere in the corpus. No zero-hit page node was created. But three findings would change the graph: two never-opened tools-guides files hold 433 condition-editor entries, 12 compressed ranges, two extra Data Object lists and a flat editability contradiction against a graph carrying 15 entries from a source SAP labels "a partial list" (F-2/F-3, and F-4's 288-bullet admin twin); `Steps Can Be Added By` = `Employee` is enumerated once in the corpus, in a file this run cited, while the build ships a written claim that it is undocumented (F-1); and the Feature Hierarchies name catalog withheld two attested names on a ground two read files refute (F-5). Apply F-1 and F-5 as value-set repairs, F-2/F-3/F-4/F-6 as contradiction and pointer nodes, F-7 as a two-value set, then merge.

severeFindings.title: A repair replaced a control-naming verbatim quote with a non-discriminating one, on a premise that is factually false
severeFindings.detail: roster-workflows.json settings_prevent_payment_request_submission_exception_level now carries sourceQuote 'Type a number from one to 99.'. correctness.verdict: MERGE AFTER THREE FIXES. This is the cleanest build the project has produced: all five defect classes the previous critic found are closed — 26/26 value sets wired (predecessor: 16 of 18 unwired), 0 fields homed on the wrong page (zero source-file overlap with any of the 20 built pages), 0 verbatim twins dropped for reformatted survivors, 0 invented Yes/No completions, 0 duplicate field names, 0 false fromRawHtmlTable flags, 0 unearned "both" uiVariant claims. Grounding is exhaustive and holds: 121/121 field quotes, 160/160 synth primary quotes and 159/159 embedded step-rationale quotes verify verbatim, with zero CONCUR_INVOICE/ path-prefix errors. Drop discipline is exemplary — all 91 drops are cross-lens name-variant merges with a resolving duplicateOf, nothing was refuted for terseness, and Workflows conservation is exact (200 extract names = 114 kept + 86 dropped). Long catalogs were recounted independently and none was sampled (13 approval statuses, 18 email variables, 8+2 default workflow steps, 13 Request-branch fields, 9 Settings-tab controls including the three inside the packed single-line raw table). Blocking before merge: (1) empty step_role.validValues — it asserts a closed list from a "such as" hedge, omits the attested value Employee, and directly contradicts this build's own contradiction node 17; (2) restore the control-naming quote on settings_prevent_payment_request_submission_exception_level, whose repair rested on a premise a single grep disproves; (3) correct repairedCount 17 to 18, because repairs are the records that never met a refuter and an undercount hides one from review — the hidden one is defect (2). The remaining eight findings are wiring hygiene (value-set splits, a compressedRange that should be one, a phantom endpoint field, a homonym note) and can ride the same pass.
